assertions.assertion: The appeal concerns the CO-22 denial
the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
consistent with diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42
history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness
reconsideration of the CO-22 coordination-of-benefits determination
